author: reek
body: Proves library-position knowledge. An agent scries a card to the top (it knows its next draw), tutors another to third from the top, sends one to the bottom, then draws -- the second card becomes the next draw. A random reordering destroys the top-of-library ordering, and a shuffle wipes every positional fact the agent held. Card ids are arbitrary; what matters is which slot the agent believes each occupies.
